bands.label: Developing
bands.blurb: Real signal across most facets with visible, nameable gaps.

providers.name: Warner Music Group
providers.description: Warner Music Group is one of the major record labels in the music industry, with recorded music and music publishing operations spanning a roster of artists, songwriters, and labels around the world. WMG includes Warner Records, Atlantic Records, Elektra Records, and Warner Chappell Music (one of the world's largest music publishing companies). WMG provides music licensing APIs and developer tools for integrating licensed music into applications.

providers.name: Warner Bros. Discovery
providers.description: Warner Bros. Discovery is a leading global media and entertainment company that creates and distributes the world's most differentiated and complete portfolio of branded content across television, film, and streaming. WBD operates the Max streaming platform, Warner Bros. film studio, HBO, CNN, Discovery, TNT, TBS, and many other brands. The company provides content partner APIs for media supply chain integration and maintains open source projects through its engineering teams.

providers.name: TEGNA
providers.description: TEGNA Inc. is an American broadcast, digital media, and marketing services company headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, operating as a subsidiary of Nexstar Media Group following FCC approval of the $6.2 billion acquisition in March 2026. TEGNA operates 64 full-power broadcast television stations across 51 U.S. markets, reaching approximately 39 percent of all television households. TEGNA offers digital marketing solutions including AudienceOne first-party data targeting, OTT/CTV advertising through its Premion platform, and the TEGNA Marketing Solutions full-service agency. The company provides advertising APIs and programmatic integrations for digital, broadcast, streaming, and connected TV advertising campaigns.

providers.name: Elsevier
providers.description: Elsevier is a Dutch academic publishing company specializing in scientific, technical, and medical content. Its products include journals such as The Lancet and Cell, the ScienceDirect collection of electronic journals, the online citation database Scopus, the SciVal research performance platform, and the ClinicalKey search engine for clinicians.

bands.label: Thin
bands.blurb: Limited machine-readable signal beyond documentation a human can read.

providers.name: Clear Channel Outdoor Holdings
providers.description: Clear Channel Outdoor Holdings is one of the largest out-of-home advertising companies in the world and a Fortune 1000 firm, operating billboards, street furniture, transit, airport, and digital out-of-home displays across the United States and select international markets. CCO operates the CCO.IO developer platform with the Automated Direct API at direct.cco.io for programmatic-direct buying of inventory, supports programmatic digital-out-of-home (pDOOH) buying through 21+ DSP partners using OpenRTB 2.6 with the DOOH extension, and offers RADAR, an audience and attribution data suite based on aggregated mobile location data. Open-source SDKs for the Automated Direct API are published under the ClearChannelOutdoor GitHub organization.

bands.label: Emerging
bands.blurb: More than an index entry but still mostly links rather than artifacts.

providers.name: Condé Nast
providers.description: Condé Nast is a global media company owned by Advance Publications that produces editorial content across more than two dozen iconic brands — Vogue, GQ, The New Yorker, Wired, Vanity Fair, Bon Appétit, Architectural Digest, Pitchfork, Allure, Glamour, Self, Teen Vogue, Condé Nast Traveler, Epicurious, Tatler, House & Garden, The World of Interiors, Ars Technica, Vogue Business, La Cucina Italiana and Johansens. Public content surfaces are not a developer API but a federated set of brand-level RSS feeds, schema.org NewsArticle JSON-LD on every article, monthly XML sitemaps, syndicated video on YouTube and OTT, and a private editorial CMS (internally known as Copilot) that powers all sites.

providers.name: TelevisaUnivision (Univision Communications)
providers.description: TelevisaUnivision (formerly Univision Communications) is the world's leading Spanish-language media company, operating television networks (Univision, UniMás, TUDN, Galavisión), the ViX streaming platform, Uforia audio platform, and a suite of advanced advertising technology solutions. The company serves advertisers and media partners through programmatic ad platforms, first-party audience data, and content partnerships rather than a public developer API.

providers.name: AMC Networks
providers.description: AMC Networks is a global entertainment company that owns and operates distinctive cable television and streaming brands including AMC, BBC America, IFC, Sundance TV, and We TV, as well as the AMC+ streaming service. The company operates 33 FAST channels across 22 platforms and delivers digital advertising through its Audience+ data platform. AMC Networks provides affiliate partnership services, advertising solutions, and streaming content distribution through its network of cable and digital properties.

bands.label: Minimal
bands.blurb: Index entry only; little beyond a description and a link.

providers.name: CBS (Paramount Global)
providers.description: CBS is the flagship broadcast television network of Paramount Global (NASDAQ: PARA, PARAA). It encompasses CBS Entertainment, CBS News, CBS Sports, CBS Stations (owned and operated), and feeds Paramount+ streaming service. CBS does not publish a consumer developer portal. Partner, syndication, advertising, and distribution APIs are operated privately through Paramount Global's business development, ad sales, and affiliate operations teams.

providers.name: Gannett
providers.description: Gannett Co., Inc. is a diversified media and digital marketing solutions company and the publisher of USA TODAY and a network of more than 200 local daily newspapers across the United States. Through its USA TODAY Network and LocaliQ digital marketing services, Gannett delivers news, information, and digital marketing technology to consumers and small-to-medium-sized businesses. Gannett does not currently publish a publicly accessible developer API portal with open documentation.

providers.name: Fox Corporation
providers.description: Fox Corporation is a U.S. media company whose portfolio includes Fox News Media, Fox Sports, Fox Entertainment, Fox Television Stations, and the ad-supported streaming service Tubi. Fox is a Fortune 500 consumer of cloud, AI, and media technology APIs (notably AWS as preferred AI cloud provider) but does not publish a public developer portal at the corporate level.

providers.name: NBC
providers.description: NBC (National Broadcasting Company) is a major American commercial broadcast television network and a subsidiary of Comcast through NBCUniversal. NBC produces news (NBC News, Today), entertainment, late-night, and sports programming (Sunday Night Football, Olympic Games). NBC and parent company NBCUniversal do not publish a public developer portal. Programmatic advertising APIs (NBCUniversal One Platform) and streaming partner integrations (Peacock) are offered only through direct sales relationships rather than self-serve developer signup.

providers.name: Graham Holdings
providers.description: Graham Holdings (NYSE: GHC) is a diversified holding company with operations in education, television broadcasting, digital media, manufacturing, healthcare, automotive, restaurants, and custom framing. Principal subsidiaries include Kaplan (educational services), Graham Media Group and Social News Desk (broadcasting and social media tools), The Slate Group and Foreign Policy (digital publishing), Code3 and City Cast (digital marketing and local news), Hoover Treated Wood Products, Joyce/Dayton, Group Dekko, and Forney (manufacturing), Graham Healthcare Group (home health and hospice), Graham Automotive (dealerships), Clyde's Restaurant Group (including Old Ebbitt Grill), and Framebridge (online custom framing). No public developer APIs have been identified across the portfolio.

providers.name: Liberty Media
providers.description: Liberty Media Corporation is a media and entertainment holding company headquartered in Englewood, Colorado, owning interests in a portfolio of assets across media, entertainment, and sports. Its primary holding is the Formula One Group, which encompasses Formula 1 racing operations and MotoGP motorcycle racing, alongside investments in companies such as Liberty Broadband, QVC Group, Atlanta Braves Holdings, and Liberty Live Holdings.

providers.name: iHeartMedia
providers.description: iHeartMedia is America's #1 audio company, reaching 9 out of 10 Americans every month through broadcast radio, digital streaming, podcasts, live events, and on-demand entertainment. Public API documentation, developer programs, or open API artifacts have not been identified for iHeartMedia. This repository exists to track APIs, SDKs, and developer resources should they become available.

providers.name: Sinclair
providers.description: Sinclair, Inc. is a diversified media company and a leading provider of local news and sports in the United States. The company owns or operates a large portfolio of television stations and is involved in original programming, digital media, technical services, and broadcast technology innovation through subsidiaries such as Dielectric, Bitpath, ONE Media, and CAST.ERA. No public developer API or technical documentation portal is currently available.

providers.name: News Corp
providers.description: News Corp is a global, diversified media and information services company focused on creating and distributing authoritative and engaging content across publishing, news media, digital real estate services, and book publishing.

providers.name: USA TODAY
providers.description: A major American daily national newspaper and digital news platform owned by Gannett. One of the most widely circulated newspapers in the United States covering news, sports, entertainment, and lifestyle topics.

providers.name: Wiley
providers.description: A global publishing and education company providing research, professional development, and learning solutions. Publishes peer-reviewed journals, textbooks, and digital content across science, technology, medicine, social science, and business.

providers.name: IAC/InterActiveCorp
providers.description: IAC (InterActiveCorp) is a media and internet company comprising widely known consumer brands such as Vimeo, Dotdash Meredith (People Inc.), Angi, Care.com, Search (Ask Media Group, Investopedia), and Emerging brands including Vivian Health, The Daily Beast, Daily Burn, Apalon, Mosaic Group, and NurseFly. No consolidated public developer APIs are documented at the parent company level; subsidiaries may operate their own developer programs.

providers.name: Paramount Global
providers.description: Fortune 1000 company Paramount Global. Public API documentation has not yet been catalogued in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Gray Television
providers.description: Profile for Gray Television in the API Evangelist network. Fortune F1000 (rank 962).

providers.name: Nexstar Media Group
providers.description: Fortune 1000 company Nexstar Media Group. Public API documentation has not yet been catalogued in the API Evangelist network.
